fee_notes: Royalty is the greater of 8% of Gross Revenues or the Minimum Royalty ($700/month for Core Program, $800/month for Plus Program); Minimum Royalty begins in month 7 after opening. National Brand Fund contribution is the greater of 1% of Gross Revenue or $200/month; franchisor may increase up to 2% upon 60 days' notice. Local Advertising currently 1% of Gross Revenues (up to 3% required). Regional Advertising Cooperative currently none (up to 3% may be required). Technology Fee is $200/month for first Soccer Stars franchise, $150/month for second YAU Brand business, $100/month for each additional YAU Brand business. Recruiting Services/Applicant Tracking System Software $20/month. Sales CRM $10/month (mandatory first 12 months). Learning Management System $50/year. Bookkeeping up to $150/month (paid to third-party). Credit Card Processing $20/month plus merchant processing fees up to 4%. Marketing_min_monthly reflects National Brand Fund minimum of $200/month; royalty_min_monthly reflects Core Program minimum of $700/month.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty: The greater of 8% of Gross Revenues or the "Minimum." For the Core Program, the Minimum is $700 per month. For the Plus Program, the Minimum is $800 per month.
National Brand Fund Contributions: The greater of 1% of Gross Revenue or $200 per month.
Local Advertising Expenditures: Up to 3% of Gross Revenues, but currently 1% of Gross Revenues.
Regional Advertising Cooperative Fee: Currently none. We may require you to contribute up to 3% of your Gross Revenues to the cooperative.
Technology Fee: $200 per month for your first Soccer Stars Franchised Business; $150 per month for your second YAU Brand business; $100 per month for each YAU Brand business thereafter.
Recruiting Services and Applicant Tracking System Software: Currently $20 per month.
Sales CRM: Currently $10 per month.
Learning Management System: Currently $50 on an annual basis.
Bookkeeping: Up to $150 per month.
Credit Card Processing Fee: $20 per month plus merchant processing fees, which can be as high as 4% of the amount charged.
